# Nilesh Raj - Founder & AI Engineer @AgentNine

## Profile
Nilesh Raj is the Founder & AI Engineer at AgentNine, based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh,
India. He builds and ships AI systems end to end, from architecture to live deployment:
agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NLP, and fine-tuned
transformer models. NVIDIA-certified in LLM application development. Open to AI Engineer
and Applied AI roles, remote or hybrid.

## Education
BCA, Artificial Intelligence (IBM Specialization), United University, Prayagraj
(Aug 2022 - May 2025).

## Core Projects
1. AgentNine: An independent, community-led directory of open-source AI agents. Each
   listing links to its upstream repository and sets out install steps for Windows, macOS
   and Linux, the access the agent requests, the version reviewed, and what is still
   undocumented. Every listing passes a 5-point verification checklist before publication.
   Built with Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Supabase Postgres,
   Fuse.js search and Vitest; deployed on Vercel.
   Live: https://agentnine.pro | Code: https://github.com/Nilesh1735/AgentNine
2. OmniCrew AI: An autonomous multi-agent B2B lead-generation platform built with CrewAI,
   featuring a 3-tier LLM fallback router (DeepSeek -> Mistral -> Gemini) for 99.9% task
   completion, Redis-backed MD5 caching, SSRF protection, and JWT multi-tenant isolation.
   Live: https://omnicrew-ai.vercel.app/ | Code: https://github.com/Nilesh1735/OMNICREW-AI
3. LumanGuide: An enterprise Agentic RAG system on a LangGraph state machine with dynamic
   document grading, a grade-and-rewrite retrieval cycle, FAISS vector search,
   prompt-injection guardrails, JWT RBAC, and LangSmith LLMOps observability.
   Live: https://lumanguide-app.streamlit.app/ | Code: https://github.com/Nilesh1735/LumanGuide-Onboarding-Illuminated

## Experience
Founder & AI Engineer at AgentNine (Varanasi, Jun 2026 - Present): founded and shipped
agentnine.pro; leads product direction and technical decisions with a small team across
product, engineering and launch.

AI/ML Trainee at Technosavvys Education Technology (Remote, Feb-May 2026): engineered a
BERT text classifier on 500+ student reviews per batch with Hugging Face (88% accuracy,
+15% over a TF-IDF baseline) and deployed a real-time Streamlit sentiment dashboard backed
by SQLite for mentors across multiple active courses.
